homeHint: Tap a glowing city, or search for it. Nothing loads until you ask.
hoursNote: Open now hides restaurants, homestays, and hotels that are closed or have no hours on OpenStreetMap. Hours are often missing.
noPlaces: No pins in this view yet. Pan if you like, then tap Search this area.
feedbackHint: Bugs, a missing place, a city that feels wrong. This stays on the free Cloudflare tier.
contact: Email or phone, if you want a reply
geoUnavailable: This browser cannot share your location.
credit: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · tiles by OpenFreeMap · weather by Open-Meteo
drawHint: Press and drag. Release near the start to close the shape. The map will not pan; scroll to zoom.
drawOpen: That stroke did not close. Release near the starting point, or draw again.
drawTiny: That shape is too small. Draw a wider loop.

errors.area_too_large: That area is too large for a free search. Draw a smaller shape so the map service can answer.
errors.area_too_small: That shape is too small to search. Draw a slightly larger one.
errors.area_outside: Draw inside Vietnam. This map only searches the country.
errors.bad_poly: Draw a closed shape, then release near the point where you started.

vehicles.title: Ways to go
vehicles.partnerNote: Operator, class, price, times, duration and stops are shown on the partner site. theHaofTravelo does not sell tickets or list fares.

notes.date-on-site: Choose the date on their site. The link does not carry it.
notes.link-only: This site does not accept a route and date in the link.
notes.no-pickup: Opens the app or website. Pickup is not filled in.
notes.same-place: Pick two different places to fill the route.
notes.other-city: Cities outside the eleven are chosen on the partner site.
notes.no-rail: This place is not on the North–South railway. See what the partner sells.
notes.vanDon: Hạ Long flights use Vân Đồn (VDO), about an hour from the bay.
notes.sameAirport: Both places share an airport, so the search is left blank.

vehicles.busLead: Bus lines tagged in OpenStreetMap for this city. Not every route is mapped.
vehicles.busEmpty: No bus routes are tagged in this part of the city yet.
vehicles.busNoInfo: No separate city bus page is linked for this place.
vehicles.busIgnored: City buses use the city above. The date and the other city stay for the other tabs.
